off_color.name: Make a cuboctahedron with the triangle faces a different colour to the square faces
Even easier, create the colour map on the command — off_color -f N -m map_3=0.0/0.0/0.0:4=1.0/1.0/1.0 cuboctahedron
Even easier, create the colour map on the command line, with — off_color -f N -m map_3=black:4=white cuboctahedron
Make dark colours for U by decreasing the value of the default map
Rather than changing a map with -r an map with the desired colours could be — off_color -f U -m rnd_H0.4:0.7 geo_2
Rather than changing a map with -r an map with the desired colours could be chosen — off_color -f U -m rand_S0.3 geo_2
Colour different elements with different maps
off_color.command: off_color -f U -m f,rnd_H0.4:0.7 -e U -m e,rnd_H0.9:1.2 geo_2

off_color.name: Colour edges and vertices with a rainbow effect
